result: In `sync_fifo`, keep the three 8-bit payload registers and direct `out_data = payload0` mapping, but add a `not_full` state bit reset to 1 and drive `in_ready = not_full || out_ready` instead of comparing occupancy to 3. Update `not_full` on the same push/pop cases as occupancy so it clears only when a push fills the FIFO and sets when a pop frees a full FIFO; hold it on simultaneous push/pop and idle, preserving full simultaneous transfers and all existing queue behavior. Add `// @latency 1`; preserve the interface, synchronous active-high reset, and observable cycles, then judge the candidate on the fixed simulation and routed setup/hold gates.
